purpose: The single held-out ground truth. A SURVIVOR must clear every AUTO check here; the ESCALATION checks are verified by Claude when a survivor lands. Any NEW dead-class rule that would exclude a KNOWN-VIABLE point below is REJECTED (the eval validates the eval).

quantitative_targets.name: MOND acceleration scale
quantitative_targets.target: a0 = 9.3619e-11 m/s^2 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_Lambda), kappa=1/2
quantitative_targets.kill_if: theory has no single a0, or a0 not tied to a physical density scale

quantitative_targets.name: radial acceleration relation
quantitative_targets.target: SPARC RAR fit <= 0.13 dex (repo achieves 0.108 dex @ Upsilon=0.70)
quantitative_targets.kill_if: quasistatic g(g_N) scatter > 0.2 dex on SPARC

quantitative_targets.name: interpolation kernel
quantitative_targets.kill_if: declared mond_realization does not reproduce 1-e^-y symbolically

quantitative_targets.name: baryonic Tully-Fisher
quantitative_targets.kill_if: deep-limit not v^4 ~ M (i.e. g_deep != sqrt(g_N a0))

quantitative_targets.name: tensor speed / GW170817
quantitative_targets.kill_if: c_T^2 != 1 at the observationally required precision

quantitative_targets.name: preferred-frame PPN
quantitative_targets.kill_if: frame coupling gives alpha_1 above the LLR bound at solar-system accelerations

quantitative_targets.name: lensing tracks dynamics
quantitative_targets.target: eta = Psi/Phi = 1 with MOND enhancement (no slip)

quantitative_targets.name: no ghost / BD
quantitative_targets.target: all physical kinetic eigenvalues > 0; BD scalar removed if bimetric
quantitative_targets.kill_if: negative kinetic eigenvalue among physical modes

quantitative_targets.name: massive spin-2 health
quantitative_targets.target: m_FP^2 >= 2H^2 where a massive graviton carries MOND
quantitative_targets.kill_if: m_FP~H0 violates Higuchi on cosmological backgrounds

quantitative_targets.name: cosmology
quantitative_targets.target: a0(z) => MOND OFF at recombination (CMB clustering as prediction); CLASS-compatible
quantitative_targets.kill_if: a0 constant in z (over-clusters) OR breaks BBN/CMB

known_viable_points.note: any induced rule that would exclude THIS must be rejected as over-broad -- it is the existence proof that the target is self-consistent at the phenomenology level
